name: Special City Council & SDWD Meeting (Strategy Workshop) February 24 & 25 8:00 a.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council & SDWD Meeting (Strategy Workshop) February 24 & 25 8:00 a.m.
AGENDA
MONDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2025 -
12:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
City Council: Mayor Ehlers, Deputy Mayor Lyndes, and Council Members O'Hara, San Antonio, and Shaffer
SDWD: President Lyndes, Vice President Ehlers, and Board Members O'Hara, San Antonio, and Shaffer.
2.
INTRODUCTIONS
3.
MEETING GROUND RULES AND OBJECTIVES FOR THE WORKSHOP
4.
PUBLIC COMMENTS (ONLY TAKEN ON FEBRUARY 24) – A maximum of 2 hours will be set aside at the beginning of the February 24, 2025, meeting, any speakers past that time will be taken at the end of the day. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
2025-02-24 & 25 Special Meetings - Agenda - Public Comments Received
5.
AGENDA ITEM Please note this is not a budget/CIP workshop. The budget/CIP workshops are tentatively scheduled for City Council meetings on March 26, 2025, and April 23, 2025.
5A.
City Council Strategic Workshop. Contact Person: Interim City Manager Campbell
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Mayor, City Council and staff to discuss organizational strategies, objectives, focus areas, goals and desired outcomes for the future.
2025-02-24 & 25 Special Meetings - Strategy Workshop Presentation Strategic Session
6.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
